scripts.dev:docs: pnpm -C docs install --ignore-workspace && pnpm -C docs run dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' run typecheck && pnpm --filter @moonshot-ai/kimi-code run typecheck && pnpm --filter kimi-code run typecheck && pnpm --filter @moonshot-ai/vis-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @moonshot-ai/vis-web run typecheck && pnpm --filter @moonshot-ai/scenarios run typecheck
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-comments.mjs && oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings && node packages/agent-core-v2/scripts/check-import-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/checks/guards.mjs && node scripts/checks/ratchet.mjs
scripts.lint:pkg: pnpm --filter @moonshot-ai/kimi-code exec publint && npm_config_cache=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kimi-code-npm-cache pnpm --filter @moonshot-ai/kimi-code exec attw --pack . --profile node16
scripts.publish: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run sherif && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run lint:pkg && changeset publish
